annotations.title: Find venues that take inquiries from assistants

description: Finds restaurants and venues on Excellent that accept private-event and group-dining inquiries from AI assistants, by the restaurant group's or the venue's name. Returns up to 10, each with the group, the venue, who replies, a handle for send_event_inquiry and the venue's public inquiry page. Only venues that opted in are listed, and only what their public inquiry page shows. No account needed.

query.description: The restaurant group's or venue's name, e.g. "Lumière" or "Harbor Room".

name: find_event_venues
